title: 第173章 临行第172章 喜欢
content_zh:
原计划虞繁花没那么早过来，待新屋建好，她过来正好合适。
现在嘛……
虞繁花哼哼唧唧一顿诉苦，说她在马车上睡着了，没发现车夫净把马车往深山老林里赶。
等她反应过来时，车夫已经把她的行李丢下，然后带着马车扬长而去，头都不带回的。
沈二扶额，不用猜也知道是虞老爷子事先安排好的。
有人盯着，虞繁花没敢靠沈二太近，奈何在这个地方，她只跟沈二熟。
虞繁花的住宿成了问题，韩执旭一早送韩三宝上学堂不在，韩正津听不进去话，沈二只好陪着虞繁花还有韩正津在院里干坐着。
“你是虞阡的闺女？”韩正津说。
“不是。”虞繁花纠正他，“虞阡是我祖父，我是他孙女，虞繁花。”
“包子都有孙女了，”韩正津点点头，“你叫什么花来着？”
“虞……”虞繁花顿了顿，担心又进入死循环，当即改口，“您喜欢叫什么我就叫什么。”
大不了多个外号，怎么说也一代掌门，比什么阿猫阿狗起的外号强多了。
“哦——”韩正津长声应着，若有所思，然后准确无误地喊出她的名字，“虞繁花，小字似锦。”
虞繁花愣了下，很想说一句：“您怕不是在玩我？”但她的教养告诉她不能这么说。
“您记性真好。”
韩正津眉眼弯弯，眼缝中满是星星点点，毫不客气地接受虞繁花的夸奖，“然也。”
“……”
沈二看着他们的互动，哭笑不得，她耳朵微动，转头看向院外，“小韩回来了。”
韩正津似无意地看她一眼。
多一个熟人在，场面一度缓和。

韩执旭还没进门，便发现院里多了个陌生面孔，不用问也能大概猜出虞繁花的来历。
“你是虞家的虞繁花？”
“对，”虞繁花已经说不清今天第几次自我介绍了，“我是虞繁花，字似锦，繁花似锦，你可以跟小二一样，喊我花花。”
毕竟以后要相处好一段时间，叫得亲近点也不是不行。
“我名韩逸，字执旭。”韩执旭顺着她的说，“你也可以跟小二一样，喊我小韩。”
好巧不巧，韩执旭也是那么想的。
虞繁花笑了笑，“好。”
交流一番下来，虞繁花才知眼前这位大爷竟然是穹山派掌门。
看着虞繁花一脸震惊，懊恼得有些无地自容的模样，沈二完全能够共情。
掌门师叔果真是一视同仁，谁都没放过。
虞繁花的提前到来，让他们的路途不得不提上日程。
百里识越一觉睡醒，听说今天下午便要出发去南国，天都塌了。
他虚弱地捂住胸口，“真的不再休息几天吗？”指了指虞繁花，“人家小姑娘才刚到。”
按理来说是要好好休息几天，可实在是条件有限，新屋没修好，住不下。
虞繁花没意见，韩正津也同意，“早去早做打算，以免路上出意外。”
韩正津的话，韩执旭必然是铭记于心。
“师父，您是不是算到什么了？”他表情严肃，看着自己的双手，“难道我们此行……”
话没说完，韩正津一记禁语咒堵上韩执旭的嘴，“万物皆有定数，且往前走便是。”
安衍眸光微闪。
韩正津拂袖将手背到身后，“去收拾东西吧。”

“……”韩执旭有话说不出，只能点头。
content_en:
The original plan was for Yu Fanhua not to come over so early. It would be a good time for her to come over after the new house was built.
Now...
Yu Fanhua groaned and complained, saying that she fell asleep in the carriage and did not notice that the driver was driving the carriage into the deep mountains and forests.
By the time she reacted, the coachman had already thrown away her luggage, and then drove off with the carriage without even looking back.
Shen Er held his forehead, and he knew without guessing that it was arranged by Mr. Yu in advance.
Someone was watching, but Yu Fanhua didn't dare to get too close to Shen Er, but in this place, she was only familiar with Shen Er.
Yu Fanhua's accommodation became a problem. Han Zhixu was not there to send Han Sanbao to school early in the morning. Han Zhengjin couldn't listen. Shen Er had to sit in the courtyard with Yu Fanhua and Han Zhengjin.
"Are you Yu Qian's daughter?" Han Zhengjin said.
"No." Yu Fanhua corrected him, "Yu Qian is my grandfather, and I am his granddaughter, Yu Fanhua."
"Baozi has a granddaughter," Han Zhengjin nodded, "What is your name, Hua?"
"Yu..." Yu Fanhua paused, worried that she would enter an endless loop again, and immediately changed her words, "I can call you whatever you like."
It doesn't matter how many nicknames he has, he is the leader of one generation, which is much better than the nicknames given by cats and dogs.
"Oh -" Han Zhengjin responded in a long voice, thoughtfully, and then called out her name accurately, "Yu Fanhua, the small characters are like brocade."
Yu Fanhua was stunned for a moment and wanted to say: "Are you kidding me?" But her upbringing told her not to say that.
"You have a great memory."
Han Zhengjin's eyebrows were curved, and the slits between his eyes were full of stars. He accepted Yu Fanhua's compliment without politeness, "Of course."
"..."
Shen Er watched their interaction, dumbfounded. Her ears twitched slightly and she turned to look outside the hospital, "Xiao Han is back."
Han Zhengjin glanced at her seemingly unintentionally.
With one more acquaintance present, the situation calmed down for a while.
Before Han Zhixu entered the door, he noticed a strange face in the courtyard. He could roughly guess Yu Fanhua's origins without asking.
"Are you Yu Fanhua from the Yu family?"
"Yes," Yu Fanhua couldn't tell how many times she had introduced herself today, "I'm Yu Fanhua, with a Chinese character like brocade and a flower blossom like brocade. You can call me Huahua like the waiter."
After all, we are going to get along for a long time in the future, so it is not impossible to call them closer.
"My name is Han Yi, and my courtesy name is Zhixu." Han Zhixu followed her lead and said, "You can also call me Xiao Han like the waiter."
What a coincidence, Han Zhixu thought so too.
Yu Fanhua smiled and said, "Okay."
After some exchanges, Yu Fanhua realized that the old man in front of her was actually the leader of Qiongshan Sect.
Seeing Yu Fanhua's shocked and annoyed expression, Shen Er could completely sympathize with her.
The head master really treated everyone equally and spared no one.
Yu Fanhua's early arrival forced them to put their journey on the schedule.
When Baili Shiyue woke up, he heard that he was leaving for the Southland this afternoon. The sky fell.
He weakly covered his chest, "Are you really not going to rest for a few more days?" He pointed at Yu Fanhua, "My little girl just arrived."
Logically speaking, I should have a good rest for a few days, but the conditions are really limited. The new house has not been repaired and cannot be lived in.
Yu Fanhua had no objection, and Han Zhengjin agreed, "Go early and make plans early to avoid accidents on the road."
Han Zhixu must have kept Han Zhengjin's words in mind.
"Master, have you calculated something?" He looked at his hands with a serious expression, "Did we go on this trip..."
Before he finished speaking, Han Zhengjin blocked Han Zhixu's mouth with a forbidden spell, "Everything has its destiny, just keep moving forward."
An Yan's eyes flashed slightly.
Han Zhengjin rolled his sleeves and put his hands behind his back, "Go and pack your things."
"..." Han Zhixu was speechless and could only nod.
